description: A port's Arrivals board (ships in port now, then ships en route by ETA) and Departures board (ships that left in the last 48 hours), as its Shiptrail page shows them, by UN/LOCODE. Each row carries the ship's MMSI for get_ship.

limit.description: At most this many rows on each list; the counts are always whole.

locode.description: The port's UN/LOCODE, such as USHNL.

name: get_port

url.description: Her page, or the port's, on shiptrail.io.

eta.description: ETA as the crew typed it, placed in the nearest year.

etaAsBroadcast.description: An ETA that is no real time, as broadcast.

etaDay.description: The UTC day of her ETA, YYYY-MM-DD: the board groups by it.

url.description: Her page, or the port's, on shiptrail.io.

inPortSince.description: When she stopped here, when known.

kind.description: The map's class for her AIS type.

lastHeard.description: For a ship no longer on the map: when she was last heard.

status.description: Navigational status as she reports it.
